title: disella cuneifolia
intro: Disella cuneifolia, commonly known as "Buchu", is a small, evergreen shrub native to the Western Cape province of South Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Disella cuneifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Disella cuneifolia include diterpenoid compounds, specifically isopimaric acid and bornyl acetate, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
